judgment.observations: The reconstruction captures the electronics-workbench layout, including the blue monitor, instruments, yellow multimeter, keyboard, overhead lamp and tangled leads. Framing is tighter: the monitor is clipped at left, upper storage is cropped, and the desktop occupies more of the image. Objects are simplified and more widely separated; the keyboard is smaller relative to the desk and the cable pile sits farther forward/right. Missing or substantially reduced details include the mouse, circuit boards, hanging pliers, papers, magnifier, right-side tool packaging and much of the background clutter. The calculator becomes a plain keypad. Instrument controls, screen content and storage labels lose detail. The reference has varied glossy plastics, metallic surfaces and worn textures; the render is flatter, cleaner and visibly grainy, with simplified cables and pale instrument housings. Overall, the scene is recognizable but differs substantially in proportions, clutter and surface appearance.
judgment.uncertain_3d_hypotheses: Some rendered cable segments appear to hover above the desktop or pass through one another, though shadows and image noise make contact ambiguous. The right-side tool holder and lamp support appear differently arranged and less clearly connected than in the reference. Actual depth, support and hidden geometry cannot be established from these images.
